answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. Picture a dawn that only one identity owns, a wharf that must pass before anything is returned, and a glacier that only lands on the survivor: a fleet buys many dawn, waits many wharf, and still collects one glacier per identity.
